Final categorization: EXCLUDED  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on LULC prediction, but it fails the core inclusion criterion of "explicit national-scale spatial implementation." The study area is Prayagraj district in Uttar Pradesh, India—a subnational, regional scale. Although the paper implements LULC prediction using MLP-Markov chain modeling, produces mapped projections for 2035 and 2050, and reports quantitative accuracy metrics (>89% classification accuracy, kappa statistics, area-based error matrices), it operates at a local/district level, not national. It also uses only one future projection scenario per time point (i.e., single "most likely" pathway to 2035 and 2050), lacking ≥2 contrasting future scenarios with quantitative comparison. Thus, it meets exclusion criteria due to regional scale focus and single-scenario projection.)
